responsibility: Implements the interprocedural support passes for GCC’s Pointer Bounds Checker (CHKP/MPX) instrumentation. This file owns the IPA-side cloning and callgraph integration needed to add bounds parameters to instrumented functions: it decides which functions and selected built-ins need wrapper or instrumented variants, creates signature-adjusted clones and builtin decl copies with added bounds arguments, links original and instrumented nodes through IPA_REF_CHKP references, and later converts original bodies into special thunks that forward to the instrumented version so reachability, visibility, and linker-resolution behavior remain correct. It also registers the simple IPA passes that perform early versioning and early/late thunk production when pointer-bounds checking is enabled.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the IPA CHKP interface: it contains the actual clone/wrapper decision logic and defines the simple IPA passes that version functions and later turn originals into forwarding thunks, whereas ipa-chkp.h only exposes the callable interface to this machinery.
